scope: Eight closed-book diagnostic probes plus one reused consumed base answer. Some probes name the target entity or change the question. Not comparative answer accuracy, independent confirmation, retrieval or a serving correction.

findings.other_probes: Named-area, rank and pairwise answers were inconsistent. Knowing one named fact did not ensure correct ranking or application of the qualifier.

interpretation: On this consumed case the base inconsistently retrieves and applies area facts. Rephrasing alone did not repair the threshold error. This is not a general causal diagnosis, a new confirmation score, or evidence that subtraction works.
